proofBoundary: Static standing-sprite concepts only. Full battle/map animation propagation, bundle build, deploy, and runtime behavior are not yet proven.

lines.lineRole: Shooter alternate with demolition, precision, or incendiary specialization.

concepts.name: Halfling Sapper
concepts.artDirection: Olive canvas and dark leather with aged brass. Add brass goggles, a compact demolition satchel, and a readable hazard-yellow fuse bundle at the belt. Preserve face, skin, hands, boots, pose, and proportions.

concepts.name: Halfling Sharpshooter
concepts.artDirection: Navy and ivory frontier coat with cool silver weapon fittings. Add a compact monocular sight and a long precision rifle carried or slung without changing the source pose. Preserve face, skin, hands, boots, and proportions.

concepts.name: Halfling Firebug
concepts.artDirection: Soot-black clothing with a crimson scarf and copper fittings. Add a clearly readable incendiary canister, singed trim, and a tiny warm ember accent without a large flame effect. Preserve face, skin, hands, boots, pose, and proportions.

lines.lineRole: Technical support alternate with gadgets, forge work, or battlefield mobility.

concepts.name: Tinker
concepts.artDirection: Verdigris teal workwear and aged brass hardware. Add raised goggles, a dense tool belt, and one compact clockwork device in hand. Preserve face, skin, body, pose, and the practical frontier-engineer silhouette.

concepts.name: Forgehand
concepts.artDirection: Blackened iron, dark leather, and hot copper accents. Add a heavy forge gauntlet and compact smithing hammer with a restrained ember glow. Preserve face, skin, body, pose, and proportions.

concepts.name: Railwright
concepts.artDirection: Navy denim, pale steel, and one hazard-yellow stripe. Add a long rail spanner and surveyor tools while keeping the same readable side-facing stance. Preserve face, skin, body, and proportions.

lines.lineRole: Durable beast alternate with guard, retaliation, or mobility specialization.

concepts.name: Plated Armadillo
concepts.artDirection: Keep the animal anatomy and pose unchanged. Rework only the shell into layered blue-gunmetal plates with aged brass rivets and a reinforced brow plate. Keep skin, claws, eyes, and underbelly natural.

concepts.name: Razorback Armadillo
concepts.artDirection: Keep the animal anatomy and pose unchanged. Rework the shell into dark iron segments with a line of readable crimson-tipped defensive spines and leather retaining straps. Keep skin, claws, eyes, and underbelly natural.

concepts.name: Dustrunner Armadillo
concepts.artDirection: Keep the animal anatomy and pose unchanged. Recolor the shell to sand and cream with streamlined plate edges, turquoise flank markings, and one small wind streamer. Keep skin, claws, eyes, and underbelly natural.

lines.lineRole: Construct alternate with assault, shock, or anti-magic specialization.

concepts.name: Assault Automaton
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the exact mechanical body, stance, and silhouette. Refinish the armor in oxide red and gunmetal, add restrained hazard chevrons, a reinforced ram plate, and a heavier striking edge.

concepts.name: Arc Automaton
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the exact mechanical body, stance, and silhouette. Refinish the armor in cobalt steel and brass, add readable cyan conductor coils, small lightning windows, and two short copper prongs.

concepts.name: Null Automaton
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the exact mechanical body, stance, and silhouette. Refinish the armor in matte black and pale silver, add sparse violet ward seals and closed anti-magic plates. Keep glow restrained and readable at sprite scale.

lines.lineRole: Burrower alternate with armor break, life drain, or desiccation specialization.

concepts.name: Glassworm
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the worm anatomy, silhouette, maw, and pose. Rework the carapace into pale teal desert glass with translucent-looking crystal ridges and faceted teeth. Keep the effect solid and readable rather than transparent smoke.

concepts.name: Bloodworm
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the worm anatomy, silhouette, maw, and pose. Recolor the body to burgundy-black with a deep crimson segmented underside, pale bone teeth, and a restrained pulsing maw accent.

concepts.name: Saltworm
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the worm anatomy, silhouette, maw, and pose. Rework the shell in bone white and cold gray with salt-crystal encrustation along the ridges and chalky mouth plates. Avoid making it look undead.

lines.lineRole: Elite shooter alternate with mobility, suppression, or curse specialization.

concepts.name: Desperado
concepts.artDirection: Recolor only clothing and equipment to a battered teal-black duster, dark leather, and a red bandanna. Add twin blackened revolvers and brass cartridges. Preserve face, skin, body, hat silhouette, pose, and proportions.

concepts.name: Marshal
concepts.artDirection: Recolor only clothing and equipment to navy, cream, and clean silver. Add a readable silver badge, ivory grips, and a controlled lawman finish. Preserve face, skin, body, hat silhouette, pose, and proportions.

concepts.name: Hexslinger
concepts.artDirection: Recolor only clothing and equipment to ash gray and muted violet. Add sickly green etched barrel runes and a very small supernatural muzzle accent. Preserve face, skin, body, hat silhouette, pose, and proportions.

lines.lineRole: Mythic flyer alternate with lightning, venom, or radiant specialization.

concepts.name: Azure Couatl
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the complete serpent anatomy, wings, pose, silhouette, head, and feather structure. Recolor scales and feathers to cobalt, white, and gold with lightning-shaped eye spots and tiny cyan accents.

concepts.name: Jade Couatl
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the complete serpent anatomy, wings, pose, silhouette, head, and feather structure. Recolor scales and feathers to emerald, black, and ivory with venom bands, darker fang tips, and restrained teal eyes.

concepts.name: Solar Couatl
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the complete serpent anatomy, wings, pose, silhouette, head, and feather structure. Recolor scales and feathers to ivory, gold, and orange with a sunburst crest and clear solar eye markings.

lines.lineRole: War-machine alternate with guarding, shock, or furnace specialization.

concepts.name: Ironclad
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the exact machine body, pose, weapon geometry, and silhouette. Refinish it in dark steel and aged brass, add an extra riveted visor plate and overlapping armor seams without enlarging the body.

concepts.name: Thunderhead
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the exact machine body, pose, weapon geometry, and silhouette. Refinish it in cobalt steel and copper, add cyan conductor coils and short lightning prongs around the cannon.

concepts.name: Hellboiler
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the exact machine body, pose, weapon geometry, and silhouette. Refinish it in black iron with furnace-orange vents, heat-darkened rivets, and a small chimney flare. Avoid a large fire effect.

lines.lineRole: Swarm alternate with tunneling, scouting, or rune support specialization.

concepts.name: Kobold Sapper
concepts.artDirection: Preserve kobold anatomy, face, pose, short proportions, and silhouette. Recolor clothing and gear to soot black, moss green, and copper. Add a compact charge, a miner pick, and a reinforced cap.

concepts.name: Kobold Scout
concepts.artDirection: Preserve kobold anatomy, face, pose, short proportions, and silhouette. Recolor clothing and gear to blue-white leather with a teal scarf. Add snow goggles and a small hooded lantern.

concepts.name: Kobold Runebearer
concepts.artDirection: Preserve kobold anatomy, face, pose, short proportions, and silhouette. Recolor clothing to indigo and charcoal. Add a small luminous cyan rune slab or compact rune banner, with no large magic cloud.

lines.lineRole: Charger alternate with frost, bracing, or magic-ward specialization.

concepts.name: Rime Ram
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the animal anatomy, horns, pose, and silhouette. Recolor fleece to white and ice blue, add crystal horn caps and a tiny frost-breath accent. Keep eyes, hooves, and muzzle natural.

concepts.name: Stone Ram
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the animal anatomy, horns, pose, and silhouette. Recolor fleece to granite gray with an ochre harness, small stone brow plate, and mineral-textured horn bands. Keep eyes, hooves, and muzzle natural.

concepts.name: Aurora Ram
concepts.artDirection: Preserve the animal anatomy, horns, pose, and silhouette. Recolor the body to charcoal and white with restrained teal-violet aurora bands on the horns and harness. Keep eyes, hooves, and muzzle natural.

lines.lineRole: Shooter alternate with frost, skirmish, or armor-piercing specialization.

concepts.name: Glacier Elf
concepts.artDirection: Preserve face, skin, hair, body, pose, bow silhouette, and proportions. Recolor clothing and armor to white, pale cyan, and silver. Add an iced bow wrap and crystal arrowheads.

concepts.name: Pine Elf
concepts.artDirection: Preserve face, skin, hair, body, pose, bow silhouette, and proportions. Recolor clothing and armor to forest green, brown, and copper. Add a fur hood and leather bow wrap with a small pine motif.

concepts.name: Crystal Elf
concepts.artDirection: Preserve face, skin, hair, body, pose, bow silhouette, and proportions. Recolor clothing and armor to dark indigo and luminous turquoise. Add a faceted bow reinforcement and crystal arrowhead.

lines.lineRole: Bruiser alternate with leadership, defense, or frenzy specialization.

concepts.name: Yeti Packlord
concepts.artDirection: Preserve yeti anatomy, face, body, pose, and silhouette. Recolor fur to tawny white and ochre, add bronze trophies, a broad leader belt, and one compact signal horn. Keep claws and skin natural.

concepts.name: Yeti Glacierkin
concepts.artDirection: Preserve yeti anatomy, face, body, pose, and silhouette. Recolor fur to clean white and pale cyan, add ice bracers and a few readable crystal ridges. Keep claws and skin natural.

concepts.name: Yeti Bloodhowl
concepts.artDirection: Preserve yeti anatomy, face, body, pose, and silhouette. Recolor fur to smoke gray with controlled crimson warpaint, bone claw caps, and sparse trophy charms. Do not add gore.

lines.lineRole: Caster alternate with spirit, fire, or ancestor-ward specialization.

concepts.name: Spirit Walker
concepts.artDirection: Preserve face, skin, body, pose, staff silhouette, and proportions. Recolor furs and clothing to charcoal and white with aurora-green spirit paint and compact luminous talismans. Avoid a large ghost effect.

concepts.name: Ember Seer
concepts.artDirection: Preserve face, skin, body, pose, staff silhouette, and proportions. Recolor furs and clothing to black, brown, and copper. Add a small orange ember bowl or staff brazier with controlled glow.

concepts.name: Ancestor Chanter
concepts.artDirection: Preserve face, skin, body, pose, staff silhouette, and proportions. Recolor furs and clothing to bone white and ochre. Add a carved antler mask or headdress and readable ancestor tokens, without undead imagery.

lines.lineRole: Siege beast alternate with cold defense, magic wards, or charge specialization.

concepts.name: Tundra Mammoth
concepts.artDirection: Preserve mammoth anatomy, tusks, pose, armor silhouette, and proportions. Recolor fur to blue gray and white, armor to cold steel, and add icebound tusk caps. Keep eyes, trunk, and feet natural.

concepts.name: Runic Mammoth
concepts.artDirection: Preserve mammoth anatomy, tusks, pose, armor silhouette, and proportions. Recolor fur to charcoal, armor to bronze, and add sparse cyan-violet runes to plates and tusk bands. Keep eyes, trunk, and feet natural.

concepts.name: Steppe Mammoth
concepts.artDirection: Preserve mammoth anatomy, tusks, pose, armor silhouette, and proportions. Recolor wool to ochre and rust, streamline the harness, and add small red pennants. Keep eyes, trunk, and feet natural.

lines.lineRole: Giant alternate with frost, storm, or earth-control specialization.

concepts.name: Jotunn Frostlord
concepts.artDirection: Preserve giant anatomy, face, body, pose, weapon silhouette, shield, and proportions. Recolor armor to white, ice blue, and silver. Add an ice-encrusted weapon edge and compact frost crown.

concepts.name: Jotunn Stormlord
concepts.artDirection: Preserve giant anatomy, face, body, pose, weapon silhouette, shield, and proportions. Recolor armor to charcoal, cobalt, and copper. Add cyan lightning runes and short conductor details.

concepts.name: Jotunn Stonebinder
concepts.artDirection: Preserve giant anatomy, face, body, pose, weapon silhouette, shield, and proportions. Recolor armor and skin accents to granite gray and bronze, with cracked-rock texture and compact earth seals.
